definitions.selection: Stable ascending scene_seed/episode_id; independent of model outcome/completion; no new seeds
definitions.unit: Distinct (task, condition, source_episode_id) within the fixed subset manifest.
definitions.n: Completed keys with boolean success and no saved error, as defined by the existing producer.
definitions.errors: Selected keys with a saved error and no accepted completed result; reported separately from n.
definitions.records: n + errors; distinct selected saved completion/error keys, not attempt count.
definitions.expected: Fixed planned sample count; never the SR denominator.
definitions.sr_percent: 100 * n_correct / n, rounded to 3 decimals; null when n == 0.
definitions.remaining: expected - n; includes unresolved errors and unrecorded keys.
definitions.comparability: All models use the same selected 550 keys; partial rows can cover fewer keys. No full2200 result totals are pooled here.
definitions.status: Row completion coverage; metadata.status retains the model execution state.
